notes: Prices sheet has 13 rows but only 12 distinct material codes: 000004 appears twice. No precedence rule is given, so the two price records for that SKU conflict; keep both alternatives visible for review rather than picking one.
Selling price contains 9999, far outside the 113–256 range of the other rows; this may be a placeholder/sentinel rather than a real price and should be reviewed before publishing.

Currency is present as explicit 'THB' in the source for every price row, so no currency clarification is required.
No VAT, unit or pack-size evidence exists in either sheet; nothing was inferred for those facts.

changes_from_draft: Root source corrected: the draft used sheet 'Prices' as the product root and mapped /sku from 'Selling price'. Root is now sheet 'Material' (products master) so the full 12-product master population and identities are preserved; 'Prices' is a linked pricing source.
Added a left join products → prices on 'Material code' with cardinality 1:N and on_unmatched=keep; the draft had no join and lost the material master.
/sku now comes from 'Material code' (cast to string, leading zeros preserved) instead of 'Selling price' (fallback was wrong).
/product_name added from 'Description' on the master sheet; it was missing in the draft.
/price now reads 'Selling price' from the prices frame via parse_number_th (qualified by source to avoid ambiguity with the joined key column).
/currency now sourced from the prices frame; the single explicit value 'THB' needs no clarification.

Prices sheet has 13 rows for 12 material codes: 000004 appears twice with different prices and no precedence rule exists, so record.dedupe is keys=['/sku'] keep='review' to keep both conflicting alternatives visible rather than silently picking one.
attributes_passthrough set to false: the target schema has additionalProperties=false, so undeclared passthrough attributes would be invalid.
No VAT, unit or pack-size facts are present in either sheet; nothing was inferred for them.
